name: GitHub
short: Official GitHub server: repositories, issues, pull requests, code search.
description: The official GitHub MCP server lets agents browse repositories, search code, manage issues and pull requests, review diffs, and automate GitHub workflows. Maintained by GitHub.

name: Playwright
short: Browser automation and web testing with accessibility snapshots.
description: Official Playwright MCP server for browser automation: navigate pages, click elements, fill forms, take screenshots, and run web tests. Uses accessibility snapshots so agents can see pages the way assistive tech does.

name: Filesystem
short: Read, write, and organize local files with configurable access roots.
description: Reference filesystem server from the official MCP collection. Agents can read, write, move, copy, and search files within allowed directories. Access is restricted to explicitly configured roots.

name: Fetch
short: Fetch and convert web content (HTML, PDF) to markdown for agents.

name: Git

name: Memory

name: Sequential Thinking

name: Time

name: Brave Search
